audience: Jasper is for teams that want brand voice and campaign workflows, and that can justify Pro at $69 a month. Marketing teams with a style guide are the fit the verdict describes. A person who only needs a chatbot should not pay that. The verdict says Pro is a lot if a chatbot is the job.

It is a poor fit for a wiki. Notion Business at $20 a seat includes the agent where the docs already are. Jasper is a writing suite. If you do not have campaigns, you do not have the problem it is priced for.
features: Pro is $69 a month, or $59 a month billed yearly. The trial is 7 days free. You can cancel monthly Pro anytime, which matters at this price. Annual Pro saves about 20%, and the yearly rate in the table is the $59 figure, not a percentage we applied ourselves.

Brand voice and campaign workflows are the pros. You are paying so the drafts sound like the brand and so a campaign is a workflow, not a pile of chats. Agents and the GEO Hub burn extra credits. The seat is not an all-you-can-eat meter for those.

Business is custom, with an annual commitment. One Pro seat is the self-serve door. More people means Business. That cons line is a purchasing rule: do not share one Pro login and call it a team plan.
limitations: Pro at $69 is the objection in the verdict. ChatGPT Plus is $20. Claude Pro is $20. If the work is one person talking to a model, Jasper is the expensive seat. The brand tools have to be worth the gap.
Extra credits for agents and the GEO Hub mean the invoice can move. We do not have a per-credit dollar rate in the data, so we do not print one. Know that the $69 is not a ceiling.
The rating is Depends. Depends means the suite is justified for a brand team and wasteful as a personal chatbot. The 7-day trial is the way to tell those apart without a theory.

faqs.q: Can a team share one Pro seat?
faqs.a: The cons say one Pro seat, and more people means Business. Business is custom and needs an annual commitment. Do not treat Pro as a team plan.

faqs.q: Does the affiliate flag change Depends?
faqs.a: No. Jasper is marked affiliate. Depends is about the $69 seat versus a chatbot. A commission does not make Pro cheaper or the verdict kinder.
